decls.name: GalUrGeneratorLowerBound
decls.rationale: Establishes display (5), the generator-rank lower bound \(d(G) \ge \ell - 1\): the everywhere-unramified elementary abelian extension \(M/F\) with \(\mathrm{Gal}(M/F) \cong (\mathbb{Z}/3\mathbb{Z})^{\ell-1}\) is a quotient of \(G = \mathrm{Gal}(F^{\mathrm{ur},3}/F)\).
